newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Rivlin, Meyer don't focus much on gold price.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Rivlin, Meyer don't focus much on gold price.

text.p: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin and Fed Governor Laurence Meyer said on Wednesday that they do not put much emphasis on the gold price in deciding the stance of monetary policy.
"I have never focused on gold as a particularly useful signal or forecaster of inflation," Meyer told the House Banking Committee.

In response to a question, Rivlin agreed that a steep rise in the gold price might signal that inflation was about to rise. "That's possible but I wouldn't give it enormous weight," she told the committee.
